units.title: SG-5.3 · Round service wired into admin routes and scheduler
Act: Confirm admin round route registration in server.New
Act: Confirm scheduler construction and start in main
Verify: Admin round route auth and mounting unit tests

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken
tests.title: Admin round endpoints reject requests without a token and accept Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given a server with admin.token tok and a temp repo_path, when the five admin round endpoints are called without Authorization, then each returns 401; with Bearer tok, none returns 401

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds
tests.title: POST /api/v1/admin/rounds without a token is unauthorized and with Bearer tok is not
tests.scenario: Given the admin token tok, when the request has no Authorization or Bearer tok, then 401 or not 401 respectively

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/open
tests.title: POST open round without a token is unauthorized and with Bearer tok is not
tests.scenario: Given the admin token tok, when the request has no Authorization or Bearer tok, then 401 or not 401 respectively

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/close
tests.title: POST close round without a token is unauthorized and with Bearer tok is not
tests.scenario: Given the admin token tok, when the request has no Authorization or Bearer tok, then 401 or not 401 respectively

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken/GET_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001
tests.title: GET round without a token is unauthorized and with Bearer tok is not
tests.scenario: Given the admin token tok, when the request has no Authorization or Bearer tok, then 401 or not 401 respectively

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken/GET_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/contributions
tests.title: GET round contributions without a token is unauthorized and with Bearer tok is not
tests.scenario: Given the admin token tok, when the request has no Authorization or Bearer tok, then 401 or not 401 respectively

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted
tests.title: Admin round endpoints are mounted when called with Bearer tok against a temp repo holding round-0000001
tests.scenario: Given a temp repo_path holding the-boys-room and round-0000001, when each of the five admin round endpoints is called with Bearer tok, then none returns 404
tests.detail: All 5 subtests passed. open and close log a git add error (temp dir is not a git repo) but respond non-404, which is what the test asserts.

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds
tests.title: POST /api/v1/admin/rounds is mounted for Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given the temp repo fixture, when called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/open
tests.title: POST open round is mounted for Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given the temp repo fixture, when called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404
tests.detail: Logs git add error from non-git temp dir; not 404.

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted/POST_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/close
tests.title: POST close round is mounted for Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given the temp repo fixture, when called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404
tests.detail: Logs git add error from non-git temp dir; not 404.

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted/GET_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001
tests.title: GET round is mounted for Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given the temp repo fixture holding round-0000001, when called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404

tests.name: TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted/GET_/api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001/contributions
tests.title: GET round contributions is mounted for Bearer tok
tests.scenario: Given the temp repo fixture holding round-0000001, when called with Bearer tok, then the response is not 404

tests.name: TestNewScheduler_UsesConfig
tests.title: NewScheduler uses the configured interval and wires the controller and round store
tests.scenario: Given a config with round.scheduler_interval 7s and a temporary storage.repo_path, when NewScheduler is built from it, then the scheduler interval is 7s and both the controller and the round store are wired.
tests.detail: PASS in 0.251s. Interval, Controller and Rounds assertions all hold.
